messages:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER: High GPU backlog detected in customer cluster 'acme-edge-17' (private). autoscaler health: ERROR. pending_pods=1248, desired_nodes=0 -> 0 (stuck). severity: P2. page: @maria_oncall :rotating_light:

maria: taking this. thanks PD. paging infra + runtime. @kevin @jun please join — looks like a private cluster provisioning hang.

ashley: seeing the same from infra metrics — node bootstrap requests are failing with image-pull or ENI attach hangs. customer reported slow/queued in their dashboard ~ 04:08 UTC.

kevin: on it. pulling logs from the cluster control plane now. suspect cloud API quota or IP exhaustion for that VPC. also seeing repeated: \"Instance create failed: ENI allocation timed out\" in controller logs.

jun: fwiw the autoscaler decided not to scale because it couldn't provision nodes — we have a scale-loopback. pods are pending with reason: \"NodeAffinity/InsufficientResources\" and some stuck in ContainerCreating.

maria: initial customer impact: their inference queue latency spiked x10, 40% requests failing with 504 on our edge routing. Asked CS to notify customer. @satya can you confirm?

satya: emailed ACME support lead at 04:15. they see errors and are routing non-critical traffic to hosted fallback but it’s impacting SLA. account team asked for ETA.

kevin: quick mitigation options: (1) manually launch a warmed node group in the customer's VPC (requires cloud quota and subnet IP availability), (2) failover traffic to another region/dedicated pool (needs config consent), (3) patch autoscaler to ignore affinity temporarily. leaning to (1)+(2) as quickest.

ashley: ops-bot, can you surface cloud provider quota and VPC free IPs for acme-edge-17?

ops-bot: cloud-check: EC2 ENI quota at 100/100 for account acme-corp; available IPs in subnet: 6. GPU instance quota (p3/p4) used 0/12. Suggest requesting ENI quota bump or reusing existing ENIs via warm pool.

jun: that explains it — autoscaler tried to create nodes but API returns ENI quota errors so node creation fails. warm pools would have avoided this.

maria: immediate plan: 1) open immediate support ticket with cloud partner to temporarily raise ENI quota (eng to provide logs). 2) manually create 2 nodes using existing ENIs if possible (kevin). 3) shift 20% traffic to hosted fallback to reduce pressure (jun + ashley). 4) notify customer with ETA 30–45m.

kevin: starting manual bootstrap: running command to create instances in acme-edge-17. if ENI quota blocks, I'll attempt attach of spare ENIs from warm pool.

kevin: logs: ```
$ kubectl get pods -n acme-edge | grep Pending | wc -l
1248
$ kubectl describe pod acme-edge-infer-5f7 | sed -n '1,120p'
Events:
  Warning  FailedCreate  3m (x120)  cluster-autoscaler  (combined from similar events): Error creating instance: API error: ENI quota exceeded
```

jun: I'll start the routing change to shift non-critical inference requests to hosted region eu-west-1 fallback. Pushing traffic config now.

ashley: I've toggled the routing rule to 80% local / 20% fallback. monitoring.

maria: cloud support confirmed the quota request is pending, but they can do an emergency +50 ENI for 15m if we accept. @kevin approve?

kevin: approve. requesting emergency bump via portal now. attaching relevant error snapshots and controller logs.

ops-bot: support-ticket created: S-78621. ETA from provider 00:18.

jun: fallback shift started, error rate dropped from 40% to ~12% within 3 minutes. queue depth decreased to ~720. still high but moving.

kevin: provider confirmed emergency ENI bump applied. trying autoscaler reconcile now.

kevin: autoscaler started creating nodes. new nodes registering. ```
$ kubectl get nodes | grep acme-edge
acme-edge-node-081  Ready  5d
acme-edge-node-082  Ready  30s
acme-edge-node-083  Ready  20s
```

maria: queued pods falling to ~130 in 8 minutes. good. continuing to scale until backlog drained.

satya: customer updated at 04:48 — they acknowledged and appreciate the update. account team asked for postmortem and timeline for warm pool enablement.

ashley: next immediate step: keep fallback at 20% for 30m to smooth demand, confirm all pending pods become Running.

jun: monitoring KV cache warming and model cold-start latency. we'll watch tail latency spikes. initial tail latency returned to baseline after 15m.

kevin: manual follow-up actions I'll take: (a) request permanent ENI quota increase, (b) enable warm node pool for acme-edge-17, (c) add autoscaler alert to surface ENI quota errors earlier.

maria: closing pager: system shows queue under 50 and error rate normalized. moving to mitigation -> postmortem. Not finalizing until we validate warm pool config.

pagerduty-bot: RESOLVE: PAGER resolved at 3060005123. incident duration ~66m.

maria: quick post-incident notes for RCA: cause = cloud ENI quota exhausted causing node create failures. contributing = no warm pool configured + traffic surge from customer model upgrade. impact = 40% request failures for ~40m, customer rerouted partially. remediation = emergency ENI bump + manual node boot + fallback routing. follow-ups: permanent quota bump, enable warm pool, autoscaler ENI error policy.

satya: scheduling customer debrief and sending formal incident update.

kevin: filing JIRA INFRA-7220 for warm pool + quota automation. tagging runtime for autoscaler change: RUNTIME-318.

jun: will add an autoscaler rule to mark ENI errors as 'scale-failed' and notify earlier; will propose smaller tactical change in next 48h.

maria: thanks all. adding notes and evidence into the incident board and assigning owners for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
